# Binding captures

Six frozen cases cover typed values, attribute substitution, rebinding, local
bodies, shared Markdown scope, property/index paths, literal-name shadowing,
helper namespaces, and first-use note evaluation. Each retains a complete model
and editable package. `capture.json` records source/package fingerprints and part
names. Tests compare XML semantically and ignore volatile generation timestamps.

These values pass into the existing layout and output paths. No new painting
operation is introduced. The captures are not real-Word visual review.
